name: Nihar
gpu_used: 2 x Tesla T4 (Kaggle GPU T4 x2; compute on cuda:0)

task1.bm25_settings: Okapi BM25 (own scipy implementation), k1=1.2, b=0.3, idf=log(1+(N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)); doc = title + abstract; lowercase \w+ tokens, sklearn English stop-words removed, Porter stemming=on; grid k1 x b x stemming (72 configs) tuned on val nDCG@10

task3.hybrid_method: weighted score interpolation of per-claim z-normalised scores over the full corpus: 0.1*BM25 + 0.9*bge-large-en-v1.5 (weights grid-searched on val, also compared against weighted RRF)

task5.retriever_used: hybrid weighted score interpolation of per-claim z-normalised scores over the full corpus: 0.2*BM25 + 0.1*MedCPT + 0.7*bge-large-en-v1.5-ft-hard (weights grid-searched on val, also compared against weighted RRF)
task5.nli_model: MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli; verifier = average of abstract-level finetuned NLI and rationale-sentence fine-tuned NLI; sentence selector = ncbi/MedCPT-Cross-Encoder (fine-tuned)
